steps.what: Find relevant continuing education and industry developments

loop.purpose: Shortlist relevant learning sources from permitted catalogues
loop.input: Supervisor learning goals and current source descriptions
loop.output: Source shortlist with relevance explanations and links
loop.check: Supervisor opens each source, checks the claimed topic coverage and rejects outdated or promotional material
loop.stop: No verifiable source or one failed revision returns discovery to manual search
loop.why_not_simpler: Keyword alerts help but cannot reliably relate varied course descriptions to a specific learning gap

steps.what: Participate in education and critically assess industry developments

tasks.design: Try native {LMS} catalogue filters and alerts first, adding a bounded source shortlist only when topic matching remains difficult. The supervisor opens sources and completes the education; summaries do not replace learning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course and publication descriptions vary, making discovery slower than simple filtering.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded relevance shortlist can point to actual sources without replacing attendance or reading.
tasks.still_hard: Source credibility and practical value need professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what is useful for the actual service and apply it responsibly.
tasks.altitude: Less source discovery time; learning obligations and judgement remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Course quality, prerequisites and service relevance

evidence.claim: Verified source shortlisting is an E1 design; the digest provides no measured continuing-education saving.

assumptions: Boundary is source discovery and participation, excluding training delivery and later staff coaching.

The supervisor enters learning topic, service context, language and date limits within ten retained s1 hours. Source descriptions come from existing catalogues; missing or unverifiable sources require manual search.
Native filters precede a loop. All 80 learning hours remain; upkeep includes changing goals and source access.
unknowns: Current discovery time and catalogue access
research_questions: Does a verified shortlist reduce discovery time without narrowing useful learning?

incremental.description: Maintain source access and relevance guidance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=10+80=90; gross 10%, minus three upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes only four discovery hours removed; attendance and critical reading never shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish the relevant facts and urgency of employee disputes or problems
Inform management about the problem and agree immediate next steps

tasks.design: Keep sensitive fact clarification and management escalation with the supervisor. Existing escalation guidance in {DOCS} supports the conversation; no recording or model summary is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Employee accounts can conflict and require confidential clarification.
tasks.enabler_now: No technology change is necessary for the retained conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Urgency, fairness and confidentiality depend on context.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish observed facts from allegations and raise the issue responsibly.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor retains the same escalation work and authority.

reach.task: Guide fair handling of an employee dispute

evidence.claim: Sensitive dispute clarification and escalation retain their labour in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's fact clarification and escalation; investigation and management decisions are outside the denominator.
No structured dispute code or automated employee assessment is required.
Existing native policy access is sufficient. No new deployment or incremental upkeep is introduced, justifying zero.
research_questions: Are supervisors clear about which problems need immediate escalation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. No sensitive conversation is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange worker breaks with adequate service coverage

steps.what: Confirm current staffing, service demand and worker break constraints
Arrange worker breaks while checking coverage and timing conflicts
Confirm break assignments with workers and adjust for live conditions

tasks.design: Configure fixed break windows, minimum coverage and skill constraints in {HCM}. The supervisor confirms today's staffing and demand, reviews the proposed sequence and discusses live adjustments before assigning breaks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual comparison of overlapping break windows and coverage is repetitive.
tasks.enabler_now: Scheduling tools support availability and conflict checks; a break sequence can use explicit constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected queues, absences and worker needs can make a valid plan impractical.
tasks.human_edge: Balance service coverage with workers' immediate needs and fair treatment.
tasks.altitude: Less break-conflict calculation; the supervisor retains final assignments.

reach.learn: Skill coverage and applicable break rules

evidence.claim: Shiftbase supports availability, scheduling, conflict warnings and time tracking; this supports the scheduling category rather than proving this break-planning design.
Applying explicit coverage constraints to a break sequence and the proposed time saving are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is intrashift break planning, excluding roster creation and actual service work.

The service supervisor produces present worker IDs, coverage skills, break windows, due times, minimum coverage and current demand adjustment in s1. All 30 hours remain for observation, capture and clarification. Contract and break rules come from existing approved workforce configuration, whose added maintenance is counted below.
Missing attendance, skill or rule data blocks the suggestion and requires manual planning in retained s2 time. s3 retains all worker discussion and live adjustment time.
Test native scheduler break constraints before custom code. No worker behaviour score or new employee self-service capture is assumed.
unknowns: Applicable national and collective break rules
Quality of attendance and skills data
research_questions: Can a parallel shift trial reduce conflict calculations without extra input capture or unfair break assignments?

already_counted.description: Live input capture, plan review and worker confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain coverage rules and inspect planning exceptions
Maintain approved workforce constraints and access

approvals.approved_version: Exact workers, break times, durations, coverage and live adjustments confirmed before communication; changes require renewed confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+16+30=76; gross 24%, minus four focal upkeep gives 20% central net. Low assumes only eight calculation hours removable when live demand repeatedly changes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Brief workers about group interests and special needs

steps.what: Clarify specific groups' interests and special service needs
Inform workers about relevant interests and special needs

tasks.design: Keep group clarification and the staff briefing as direct conversations. Existing booking context in {CRM} may support them; no new profiling or sensitive-data summary is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful service details need clarification and careful explanation to staff.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing booking information and direct briefing are sufficient.
tasks.still_hard: Staff need practical understanding without unnecessary disclosure of personal details.
tasks.human_edge: Explain respectful service adjustments and check staff understanding.
tasks.altitude: Group briefing work and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Necessary information sharing and accessible service options

evidence.claim: Clarifying group needs and briefing workers remains human conversation, with no assumed paperwork saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's clarification and staff briefing, excluding organiser preparation and workers' service delivery.
No new structured needs category or automated profiling is introduced.
Existing native booking access remains sufficient. No deployment or incremental maintenance is added, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Local information-sharing permissions and group requirements
research_questions: Can staff explain the practical adjustment while avoiding unnecessary personal disclosure?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Clarification and briefing remain unchanged.
